_comment: Sample question pack: 24 made-up general-knowledge questions, 3 rounds of 8, using all five question types. Replace it with your own (see README, 'Writing your own questions'). Images live in app/static/questions/. On number_wheel, `span` is how far off a guess can be before it scores zero, and min/max set the dial's range.
